title: Phase-5 verify gate (phase-advance.sh) does not cover the local git-merge ship path that has been the STANDARD since S57 — Phase 5 enforcement silently degraded from MEX to discipline-only
mechanism: phase-advance.sh (Phase 5 gate) vs actual S57-S67 ship practice
evidence: kit/hooks/phase-advance.sh:48-52 op-detect matches ONLY `*"gh pr merge"*` and `gh api ...pulls/*/merge` — no `git merge` branch. review-gate.sh:51-58 DOES match `*"git merge "*` (asymmetry). Actual ship path since S57: SPRINT_STATE.md:14 «Push отложен (оператор — накопить, один push позже)», :44 «8 Ship | done | squash main c1d2232»; git log main shows local squash commits (c1d2232 «squash feature/sprint-67-...», c474f84 «squash of feature/sprint-57-...»); no PRs exist because push is deferred → `gh pr merge` never runs. review-gate fires on the squash-merge but enforces ONLY money-path artifacts (review-gate.sh:127-129 → exit 0 for kit sprints). `git tag` is gated by nothing: `grep -ln 'git tag' kit/hooks/*.sh` → empty. Net: for all 11 mega-run sprints the only Phase-5 check was skill-manifest.sh run by skill discipline inside sprint-finish (Step 6c).
why_weak: Repo CLAUDE.md and sprint-flow-ru advertise «Hook phase-advance.sh блокирует merge если Phase 5 != done» as a MECHANICAL guarantee, but the operator's current ship flow (accumulate local squash-merges + local tags, one deferred push) structurally never triggers it. This is non-adversarial guarantee loss — the exact P0-BRANCH failure mode (gate disarmed by routine practice change) recurring one level up. All push-keyed gates similarly fire only once at the final batched push, long after the failing sprint's context is gone.
proposed_direction: Extend phase-advance op-detect to `git merge <sprint-ref>` / `git merge --squash` (mirror review-gate's round-6 normalization + plumbing exclusions), OR fold the Phase-5-done check into review-gate's already-working git-merge path. Long-term aligns with KIT-OD-1 root-fix «key gate off branch/diff state, not command string». Optionally gate `git tag v0.1.0-alpha.*` on manifest exit 0.

title: Round-5 self-skip removal incomplete: 9 of 12 Bash-matcher hooks retain content-based self-skip, including 5 BLOCKING gates; wiki-broken-link's pattern is broad enough to disarm accidentally
mechanism: S61 round-5 bypass-hunt fix (self-skip = zero-forgery bypass) — applied only to sprint-flow-check / phase-advance / review-gate
evidence: Self-skip cases still present (kit tree = live tree, verified zero drift): adr-agent-sync-check.sh:48-49, adr-index-sync-check.sh:45-46, wiki-broken-link-check.sh:45-46 (incl. ultra-broad `*"hooks/"*"-check.sh"*) exit 0`), docs-broken-link-check.sh:24, docs-staleness-check.sh:27, sprint-state-freshness-check.sh:43-44, state-integrity-check.sh:21 (`*state_integrity.py*`), state-backup.sh:15, pertask-state-warn.sh:22. Contrast: the 3 phase gates carry round-5 comments «НЕТ content-based self-skip ... детект операции решает» (sprint-flow-check.sh:38-41, phase-advance.sh:39-42, review-gate.sh:29-35). Reproduction of the accidental case: a compound command like `bash -n kit/hooks/docs-staleness-check.sh && git push` matches wiki-broken-link-check.sh:46 → broken-link BLOCK gate silently exits 0; same command also skips both adr-sync gates via `*"hooks/"*"sync-check"*`... pattern at adr-agent-sync-check.sh:49.
why_weak: Same zero-forgery bypass class S61 rated worth fixing (round-5 MEDIUM/HIGH), left open on 5 blocking gates (adr-agent-sync, adr-index-sync, wiki-broken-link, docs-broken-link, freshness) plus the crash-durability pair (state-integrity/state-backup). Unlike the phase gates, the trigger is realistic NON-adversarially during kit-maintenance sprints, where push commands routinely reference hook paths — a guarantee that silently switches off exactly when the kit itself is being modified.
proposed_direction: Apply the proven round-5 pattern uniformly: delete self-skip cases; op-detect decides (bare hook test invocations contain no `git push` → fall through to `*) exit 0`); hook-test skill already prescribes direct stdin invocation. One mechanical sweep + extend kit/hooks/tests regression to assert no `*<own-name>*) exit 0` remains.

title: Phase-5 'done' row not bound to sprint number in phase-advance and skill-manifest — stale table from a previous sprint satisfies the gate (review-gate's M-4 guard was not propagated)
mechanism: phase-advance.sh Phase-5 row parse + skill-manifest.sh Phase-5 row; SPRINT_STATE staleness after crashed/un-reset session
evidence: kit/hooks/phase-advance.sh:106 `grep -E '^\| ?5[ .]?[Vv]erify ?\|' ... | head -1` then :127-131 accepts done/skipped — no comparison of SPRINT_STATE frontmatter `sprint:` against branch sprint number. kit/skill-manifest.sh:49 same unbound grep. Contrast review-gate.sh:139-145 (security M-4, S62): «строка Фазы 6 засчитывается только если SPRINT_STATE ведёт ЭТОТ спринт» — state_sprint != sprint_num → row discounted. Live SPRINT_STATE right now holds S67's all-done table (SPRINT_STATE.md:35-45): starting feature/sprint-68-* without resetting the table → `gh pr merge` passes Phase-5 gate on S67's stale «done», and skill-manifest prints a false ✓ 5 Verify.
why_weak: This is precisely the tasked hunt class «enforcement that depends on SPRINT_STATE fields a crashed session leaves stale». The kit already judged this binding necessary (M-4 in review-gate) but fixed only one of three consumers — an intra-kit consistency gap, not a new design question. Distinct from KIT-OD-2 (deliberate forgery, backlogged): here the bypass is accidental staleness.
proposed_direction: Port the M-4 three-liner into phase-advance (state_sprint vs branch sprint_num → treat row as absent → existing FAILED path fires) and into skill-manifest (`grep '^sprint:'` == $N else row 5 = ✗). Add one case each to test_phase_gate_canon.sh.
